title: Term Life Insurance Face Size Bands: Converted Quarterly Installment
content:
**Term Life Insurance — face size band factor for the converted quarterly installment** (the installment set when a policy is converted to quarterly direct billing after its monthly bank-draft privilege ends at the returned-draft limit).

The band factor applied to the face premium of the converted quarterly installment is read from the **band measurement face** on one of two ladders.

- **Band measurement face.** When an in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy are both on record for the insured, it is the term face amount on record plus both permanent face amounts; when exactly one of the two is in force for the insured, the term face on record plus that one permanent face amount; otherwise the term face on record alone.
- **Which ladder.** The renewable ladder applies to the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term and to any term policy past its level premium period; the level term ladder applies to a level term policy within its level premium period. A level term policy is past its level premium period once the whole months from its issue date to today reach twelve times its premium guarantee period in years (120 months for the Ashgrove Level Term 10, 240 for the Ashgrove Level Term 20).

| Band measurement face (USD) | Level term ladder | Renewable ladder |
|---|---|---|
| 1000000 or more | 0.74 | 0.82 |
| from 500000 up to 1000000 | 0.80 | 0.86 |
| from 250000 up to 500000 | 0.88 | 0.92 |
| below 250000 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Band measurement face exactly 500000 on a level term policy in its 4th policy year: 0.80. At 499999.99: 0.88.
- Term face 200000 and one in-force whole life policy of 60000 on the insured: band measurement face 260000; on the renewable ladder, 0.92.
- An Ashgrove Level Term 10 with 125 whole months since issue and a band measurement face of 1000000: past its level premium period, renewable ladder, 0.82.
